summary: Phase 45 (Target Proyek & Budget/RAB) - Comprehensive backend and frontend testing completed. Backend APIs working correctly (22/25 tests passed, 3 false failures due to test expectations). Frontend UI fully functional with all tabs, dialogs, and interactive elements working. RBAC correctly enforced. One intentional overbudget item (OPS-OVERHEAD) for testing warnings.

notes: 3 backend test 'failures' are actually false positives due to incorrect test expectations, not actual bugs:
1. Preview endpoint returns 'before/after/changes' structure (not 'periods' array) - this is CORRECT behavior
2. Budget summary returns data in 'totals' object (not directly in data) - this is CORRECT behavior
3. Target activation failed because project already has active target 'Target 2026' - this is CORRECT behavior (prevents duplicate active targets)

ui_bugs.issue: Modal dialog overlay intercepts clicks when trying to close dialog and click buttons behind it
ui_bugs.workaround: Use Escape key or close button to close dialog first
ui_bugs.note: This is a common modal dialog behavior, not critical
